description: Models the hydrogen bond as the h²-suppressed weak crossing of the substrate q-deformation parameter h = q₀−q₀⁻¹ ≈ 0.209: E_HB = h²·E_cov, h² ≈ 0.0437 ≈ the measured H-bond/covalent ratio (~0.044). The H-bond is GATED by the sp³↔pure-p flip (reused from hybridization_sp_gap_braid: Δ(n) ∝ (n−1) inner-shell penetration, discrete flip at n=2→3) — a directional H-bond needs an sp³ (directional) acceptor lone pair, so period-2 atoms H-bond and period-3+ (pure-p) do NOT. Per-molecule cohesion L = n_HB·h²·E_cov for the sp³ hydrogen-bonders. No fit (h² from q₀; the gate is the already-derived bond-angle flip; E_cov and L_obs experimental; n_HB from lone-pair structure). RESULT: period-2 H₂O and HF land within ~1–2% of the measured latent heat; period-3+ H₂S/Se/Te have the H-bond correctly OFF (their L is dispersion, separate physics). The SAME flip sets the bond-angle base (merged) AND the boiling point — unifying the angle and temperature results. Wires prop:quantum-ideal-gas-law (T_q=ℏ_q) + the boltzmann-constant Kelvin bridge k_B T_phys = ℏ_q.

data.finding: The hydrogen bond is the h²-suppressed weak crossing of the substrate q-deformation parameter h = q₀−q₀⁻¹: E_HB = h²·E_cov, h² ≈ 0.0437 ≈ the measured H-bond/covalent ratio. It is GATED by the sp³↔pure-p flip (Δ(n)∝(n−1) inner-shell penetration, discrete at n=2→3; hybridization_sp_gap_braid): a directional H-bond needs an sp³ (directional) lone pair, so period-2 atoms H-bond and period-3+ (pure-p) do not. With net H-bond counts from the braid/VSEPR, the no-fit cohesion L = n_HB·h²·E_cov reproduces the latent heat of the period-2 hydrogen-bonders H₂O (~1%) and HF (~2%); H₂S/Se/Te have the H-bond correctly OFF (their L is dispersion, separate physics). The SAME flip sets the bond-angle base AND the boiling point — unifying the angle and temperature results. T_boil then follows from L/ΔS_vap, with ΔS_vap the next q-entropy quantity (⟨S_q⟩ / ice-residual). Tier: near-match (O,F); H-bond gate derived; dispersion baseline for pure-p hydrides is separate (open).
